title: Too Good To Be True? - Yoeleo SAT C45 DB Pro NxT - Chinese Gravel Wheelset Review

takeaways.text: Supplied free by Yoeleo. Quoted at about £800 (about US$999) in March 2025 with free shipping to the UK, EU and US, a 3-year warranty (extendable for a fee) that requires registration.

In-house hubs with a labyrinth end-cap seal and O-ring, double-sealed TPI steel bearings, a DT-style 36T star ratchet (54T upgrade available), captive J-bend-free spoke heads and Pillar aero steel spokes; only the freehub was offered as a spare on Yoeleo's site.
Rims are 45 mm deep, 27 mm internal and 34 mm external, hooked and hole-free (no rim tape); the reviewer weighed 645 g front and 746 g rear (1,391 g).
Truing-stand checks found about 0.1 mm lateral and 0.3 mm radial runout on both wheels, his best result so far, with spoke tension within 10% bar one spoke and correct dish.
The 27 mm internal width means tires of at least 35 mm, so the wheels are gravel-only; system limit is 135 kg.

disclosure: The creator states that YOELEO sent the wheels free of charge; the description also carries affiliate links and a discount code.
summary: Detailed workshop evaluation of the SAT C45 DB Pro NxT gravel wheelset. The creator does not name the hub generation; the current store version lists NxT SL2 hubs.
